log_dir.description: Directory path where slurm-client-emulator stores its log files.

debug_mode.description: If true, enables verbose debugging output in the emulator logs.

slurmctld_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Slurm controller daemon (slurmctld) to emulate interaction with.

slurmctld_port.description: TCP port number used to communicate with the Slurm controller daemon.

client_user.description: System user account used to run the slurm-client-emulator processes.

client_group.description: System group account associated with the client user.
